annotations.title: U.S. company intelligence: SEC profile, 3-year financials, risk signals and recent news in one call

description: Use when an agent researches a U.S. public company (due diligence, investing, competitors) and wants one sourced brief instead of many calls. Input: ticker or cik, optional news=false. Output: JSON profile, 3 fiscal years + latest quarter + balance sheet from SEC XBRL, YoY growth, rule-based risk signals (8-K items, late filings, losses) with evidence, recent 8-K events, latest news (title, link, date, publisher summary), sources. Use instead: sec_filings for the filing list or one mode only; sec_insider_trades for insider trades. Example: ?ticker=NVDA Price: $0.035 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key; give ticker or cik

ticker.description: U.S. ticker (NVDA, BRK.B); give ticker or cik
